quote_zh: WO 99/06339 discloses a process for preparing substituted benzyl bromides by brominating the corresponding methyl aromatics in the presence of azocarboxylic esters or azonitriles and in the presence of an oxidizing agent. In this case, one substituent is electronegative and is from the group fluorine, chlorine, bromine, alkoxycarbonyl, cyano and nitro. Disadvantages of this process are the use of an additional oxidizing agent and the not always satisfactory yields.
